devdoc.details: Manages on-chain authenticity while keeping encrypted files off-chain (IPFS). Key Features: - Certificate issuance and revocation by authorized issuer - Granular access control for certificate verifiers - Privacy-preserving design (no PII stored on-chain) - Batch operations for efficient gas usage - Event logging for audit trails Architecture: - On-chain: Certificate existence, validity, and access permissions - Off-chain: Encrypted certificate files on IPFS - Backend: Enforces access and serves decrypted content to authorized parties

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

AlreadyIssued().notice: Thrown when attempting to issue a certificate that already exists

AlreadyRevoked().notice: Thrown when attempting to revoke an already revoked certificate

CertIsRevoked().notice: Thrown when trying to approve access to a revoked certificate

NotFound().notice: Thrown when trying to access a certificate that doesn't exist

approveAccessBatch(bytes32[],bytes32).notice: Partial-success batch: skips bad entries, returns which failed.

userdoc.notice: A blockchain-based certificate management system for issuing, managing, and controlling access to digital certificates.
